Shows production, collections, visits and cash result for the day and the month, the comparison between branches, the best-selling services, patients seen per day and the trend over the last months. It's read-only: the data comes from invoices, payments, attended appointments and expenses entered in the rest of the system.
screens.summary: Dashboard: how the clinic is doing today and this month.
tips: «Today» and «month to date» don't change with the period: they're always the current day and month. The period affects Branches, Best-selling services and Patients per day.
Collections are always shown consolidated even if you choose a branch: payments don't record a branch.
If an indicator says «no data» it's because nothing has been entered yet (for example, expenses in Cashier), not because it's zero.

tips: The schedule refreshes every minute on its own and lets you know when an appointment comes in, changes, is rescheduled or reassigned to you.

When the clinical session is saved, the appointment becomes Completed.
In «My calendars» you see a room's appointments even if they're not yours.
